character_notes.luxury_profile: Castlemore is Brampton's recognized luxury estate neighbourhood — large 2-storey detached on large lots, some mansion-scale homes. Average price $1.3M+ vs Brampton-wide $895K.
character_notes.family_concentration: 64% families with kids, 43% households have 5+ people, 22% multi-family. Very high family density — extended families under one roof common.
character_notes.south_asian_dominant: 57% East Indian — the highest of any Brampton neighbourhood in this study. Strong Punjabi-speaking community (8%).
character_notes.new_construction: 97% of homes built post-1991. The neighbourhood largely did not exist before the late 1990s/2000s development wave.
character_notes.high_ownership: 92% ownership rate — matching Credit Valley. Renters are rare.
